parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description: The language in which you want the results to be displayed. Valid values: zh (default): Chinese. en: English

parameters.name: Describe
parameters.description: The description of the namespace that you want to create for Microservices Governance.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the namespace that you want to create for Microservices Governance.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The tag key of the resource. You cannot specify an empty string as a tag key. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with aliyun or acs:. It cannot contain http\:// or https\://.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.
